content: 🐾 Petfolio GitHub npm v1.0.1 · MIT licensed Drop a desktop pet onto any website. Petfolio is a Shimeji-style PixiJS companion that walks, crawls, jumps, waves, and responds to dragging — all with zero configuration . One line of code and your page has a mascot. terminal $ npm install petfolio summon a pet in one line import from ; const pet = Petfolio . summon (); Star on GitHub → View on npm One import, one line. The pet auto-starts and self-manages. Idle, walk, crawl, jump, wall-grab, ceiling crawl, and emotes. Pick it up, throw it — physics handle the rest. State-machine driven random behavior. Or take full control. summon, changeState, startAuto, stopAuto, destroy. That's it. Use it in any project, commercial or otherwise. © Petfolio · MIT license Built with Next.js · Source on GitHub
